text:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged traffic shift for release r2026.03.21-rc2 -> v2.14.0 on router group 'api-edge' at 10% (start).
maya: Quick question — are green instances accepting new sessions or only existing session drain?
jorge: We set session_affinity=cookie. New sessions go to green, old cookies stay on blue for 15m by cookie TTL.
liam: Observing slight p95 creep on the canary in eu-west1 (1.2s). Can we hold at 10% until we confirm?
sre-ops: Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/edge/edge-latency?orgId=1 :eyes: p50 stable, p95 spike correlated with increased DB read lat.
maya: Pause shift. Proposal: pin at 10%, open 30m change window, owner = maya. Anyone object?
anya: +1. Also suggest tightening healthcheck timeout to detect degraded pods faster.
deploy-bot: Shift paused at 10%. Pin applied. Notifying on-call and release channel. Automated watch active.
jorge: If we need full rollback, command ready: `gctl route set-weight api-edge v2.14.0=0 v2.13.9=100` — remember to run during quiet window.
liam: Agree to hold. Set rollback threshold: p95 > 1.0s for 3 consecutive minutes across >=2 zones.
maya: I'll own the rollback decision. If threshold hit, I'll instruct infra to execute the rollback command above.
deploy-bot: Note: this release includes a KV-cache key prefix change. If we rollback, clients may have stale cache entries — consider invalidation.
sre-ops: Recommend also applying a per-route concurrency cap for the canary: `concurrency: 50` to limit amplification.
maya: Documenting in release notes: change window 30m, pinned at 10%, owner maya, rollback threshold p95>1s/3m. Starting watch.
liam: I'll monitor traces and tail flamegraphs. Posting trace link every 5m.
deploy-bot: Automated watch: posting latency snapshots every 5m. Current pinned shift: 10%.

[~8 minutes later]
deploy-bot: ALERT: p95 exceeded 1.0s for 4 minutes in eu-west1 for v2.14.0 canary. Escalating to on-call.
sre-ops: Confirming. Increase in read latency from DB also visible. This looks like cache-miss storm on green.
maya: Given the threshold and cross-zone signal, I'm green-lighting rollback. Jorge, please execute the rollback command now.
jorge: Executing: `gctl route set-weight api-edge v2.14.0=0 v2.13.9=100` — applying router changes.
deploy-bot: Router update applied. Traffic now 100% -> v2.13.9. Rolling back r2026.03.21-rc2. Notifying release and infra channels.
liam: Confirming p95 returning to baseline after shift back. I'll continue to watch for next 10m.
anya: Adding to release notes: rollback due to p95 increase tied to KV-cache key change. Action items: pin diff, add client cache invalidation, add more conservative throttles.
maya: Opening a 'hotfix-needed' ticket and assigning to eng-ml + infra to investigate KV-change fallout. Thanks all for quick action.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed and watch closed. Please file postmortem if further follow-up required. :white_check_mark:
maya: Will draft RCA and schedule a follow-up sync in next daily. Closing out this thread.
